data.name: Shekar
data.gender_notes: Shekar is used as a masculine name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Shekar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhar', which means 'Lord of the Mountains'. It is a powerful and strong name, associated with prosperity and abundance. In Hindu mythology, Shiva, the god of destruction, is often depicted as residing on the mountain Kailash. As such, the name Shekar is a tribute to the divine power and strength of the mountains.
data.spiritual_meaning: Shekar is a sacred name, representing the divine power and strength of the mountains. It is a reminder of the connection between the earthly world and the divine realm, and is a source of inspiration and courage for those who bear this name.
data.etymology: Shekar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Mountains.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shekar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
